Therefore, `makepkg --printsrcinfo` is safe to run on this PKGBUILD.
</details>

<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The file is a Bash script (`navicat-close-on-exit`) that manages the Navicat premium-lite application. It launches `/opt/navicat-premium-lite/AppRun` as a detached session, waits for the process to initialize, and then monitors it while ensuring a window remains open. The script uses standard process management techniques (pgrep, kill -0, trap handlers) and relies on external utilities like `wmctrl` for window detection. There are no signs of supply chain compromise, unauthorized network activity, data exfiltration, or malicious code injection. The script performs only its intended function of keeping the Navicat process running and cleaning up on exit. All operations are confined to the application's own scope and follow standard packaging practices.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
